verdict.rationale: Bruno's documented local-first design means the vendor retains no data. It is offline-only, has no cloud sync and no account, stores collections as plain files on the user's filesystem, and its BYOK AI routes no data through Bruno servers. Users therefore keep custody of their data, but Bruno documents no explicit retention or deletion controls. Missing for 10: documented in-product retention settings or deletion controls (e.g. clearing history, cached responses or AI chat logs), any statement on retention of AI-related data, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: No cloud sync. No account. No login. We have zero visibility into your requests, and we're not training AI models on your data.
Bruno is offline-only. There are no plans to add cloud-sync to Bruno, ever.
Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem.
No data is routed through Bruno servers.
